subject.title: feat(usage): show the account email with plan windows in the chat context popover

question: Should account email become a supported optional provider-usage and gateway-status contract, including exposure in the authenticated chat UI?
rationale: This is an additive but public plugin/API and privacy surface; implementation correctness alone cannot establish whether maintainers want account identity propagated through these contracts.

options.title: Accept optional identity contract
options.body: Keep the fields optional, fix active Codex attribution, document the ownership and privacy expectation, and require real provider/UI proof.

options.title: Keep identity internal
options.body: Avoid expanding public plugin contracts by resolving account identity through owner-specific internal status paths.

options.title: Pause account display
options.body: Leave plan windows account-neutral until a broader multi-account identity design is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept optional identity contract
recommendation.body: Keep the fields optional, fix active Codex attribution, document the ownership and privacy expectation, and require real provider/UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest supplied history on the adjacent Codex/Claude session and chat UI behavior, though final contract approval should include the relevant plugin and gateway owners.
